student-template-flag-bomb-v1-normal.name: student-template-flag-bomb-v1-normal
student-template-flag-bomb-v1-normal.description: Use the eight original opening hypotheses to direct native Flag/Bomb objectives without rollouts.
student-template-flag-bomb-v1-normal.model: Fixed source-informed 80% opening-template mixture plus 20% uniform legal-army background. Native evaluator receives only Flag/Bomb marginals; mobile ranks remain exchangeable.

student-template-quiet-occupancy-v1-norm.name: student-template-quiet-occupancy-v1-normal
student-template-quiet-occupancy-v1-norm.description: Use public template mobile occupancy beliefs in the quiet old-minus-new contact danger term.
student-template-quiet-occupancy-v1-norm.model: Unchanged 80% eight-source-template /20% uniform public posterior and constrained Q12 Flag/Bomb packets. Quiet moves only: replace count-based MAX old-minus-new contact danger by the same count-conditional danger scaled by each concealed token mobile Q12 probability. Known contacts and Scout rays retain native semantics, with vacated source occupancy. All capture/terminal scores unchanged. Native goals and other nonlinear tactical conditions retain native danger; this is a score-component bridge. Single ranked native search, actual-choice history repair, no extra RNG/search.
student-template-quiet-occupancy-v1-norm.information_model: Own army, source-informed population prior and public events only. No enemy setup, referee position or private deployment seed.
